channel.description: Findings from simulated Magic: The Gathering Limited games

item.title: Reality Fracture draft primer
item.description: One page for the format before release. 100,000 simulated games next to what Limited Resources, Limited Level-Ups, Lords of Limited and TCGplayer's reviewers expect. Both sides make red-green the best pair. They split on blue, which the experts love and the simulation ranks last.
